notes.title: NEW! Deluxe Rolls!
notes.content:
It's time to Roll to Riches!! With Deluxe Rolls, you can multiply the chips you get from your Boardwalk up to 5000x! 

Get Golden Rolls to get up to 500x more chips, and Diamond Rolls to get up to 5000x more! Now it's the time to upgrade your Boardwalk and get millions of chips! Claim your free Golden Roll and try it out for free!

You can also get more Deluxe Rolls from the Deluxe Rolls shop in the Boardwalk!

notes.title: Las Vegas Sit & Go is now open!
notes.content:
Las Vegas Sit & Go is now live! Play in the Las Vegas & Go with a buy-in of 100 million chips to win a first prize of 300 million chips and a ring point or a second place of 150 million chips. Win 20 times to collect 20 ring points and unlock the Las Vegas ring!

You can also play for free by using a Las Vegas ticket. Las Vegas tickets don't expire! All players can play - if you're above 60, it will be automatically unlocked! If you're under level 60, you can unlock it early by paying a quantity of 10000 MONOPOLY Money. Don't wait up and start claiming your spot at the leaderboards!

For a limited time only, you can get limited-edition Las Vegas stickers to celebrate the inauguration! 

And of course, the official color of Las Vegas is neon - so the Neon Calendar has also started! Complete your daily missions to claim a big final reward!

Don't forget to check the shop for amazing and exclusive offers!

notes.title: Welcome to the Pool Party Sit & Go!
notes.content:
Time to make a big splash and get rich playing at the Pool Party! Become shark at the pool and beat all your opponents for a first prize of 75 million chips and the ultimate summer ring - the Pool Party ring!

Get 15 ring points to claim the new Pool Party ring! You can play at the new Sit & Go with a buy-in of 25 million chips or a Pool Party ticket. You can get a free Pool Party ticket by completing missions!

Complete your missions to get all the fun Pool Party stickers and use them at the poker tables to let everyone know who rules the party! You can also get them from the Deals shop!

New Pool Party tokens await for you! Unlock them and collect them all by completing the Community Challenge every week! They are limited edition, so they will not be obtainable after the Pool Party is over! 

Don't forget to check the shop for refreshing limited time offers! 

The Pool Party Sit & Go will end on October 2nd, 2023.

notes.title: World Tour: Amsterdam!
notes.content:
It's time for another World Tour, and this time we're going to Amsterdam!

Play in the Amsterdam Sit & Go and win up to 75,000,000 chips! Unlock the charming Amsterdam ring by claiming 15 ring points and show it off at the tables!

Work hard to complete all missions and unlock all the limited-edition Amsterdam tokens and stickers! You can claim them by completing the daily and weekly missions - find them in the mission chests!

Please note: World Tour Amsterdam Sit & Go will end on August 21st, 9 am CEST

notes.title: Anniversary Sit & Go
notes.content:
It's our Anniversary! Let's celebrate 3 years together!

Play in the Anniversary Sit & Go and win up to 75,000,000 chips! Unlock the exclusive 3rd Anniversary ring by claiming 15 ring points and show it off at the tables forever! 

To really get into the birthday mood, don't miss the chance to collect all the Anniversary stickers! You can claim them by completing the daily and weekly missions - find them in the mission chests! To collect the exclusive Anniversary tokens, you will have to work with your Community to complete the weekly challenge and unlock the Level 4 Chest! 

You can join the Anniversary Sit & Go with a buy-in of 25 million chips. You can also use an Anniversary Lounge VIP-Pass ticket to play a free game. To claim free tickets, complete your missions and collect them from the diamond mission chest! Each ticket allows you one free game in the tournament!

Time to party!

Please note: Anniversary Lounge VIP-Pass tickets will only be valid while the event is active. The Anniversary Sit & Go will end on July 9th at 9 am CEST.

notes.title: World Tour: Paris 🗼
notes.content:
[i]Bonjour[/i]! Let's travel together - It's time to visit Paris!

Play in the World Tour: Paris Sit & Go and win up to 75,000,000 chips! Unlock the very special Paris ring by claiming 15 ring points and add it to your collection. 

Do you want some really cool stickers to show off at the tables? Complete the daily and weekly missions to find them in the mission chests. If you want some cool new Paris tokens, team up with your Community to conquer the weekly challenge and unlock them from the highest level chest reward! 

You can join World Tour: Paris with a buy-in of 25 million chips. You can also use a Paris ticket to play a free game of World Tour: Paris, and you can claim free tickets from the diamond mission chest! Each ticket allows you one free game in the tournament!

Don't miss the flight! 

Please note: Paris tickets will only be valid while the event is active. World Tour: Paris will end on May 28th 9 am CEST.

notes.title: Lucky Clover! 🍀
notes.content:
Is Fortune smiling at you? Test your luck now at the new Lucky Clover Sit & Go and win up to 75 million chips! Claim the shiny Lucky Clover by earning 15 ring points - win 15 times to unlock the ring and add it to your collection! And, of course, you can also win the 2nd prize of 37.5 million!

Do you want some stickers to show off at the tables? Complete the daily and weekly missions to find them in the mission chests. If you want some cool new Lucky Clover tokens, team up with your Community to conquer the weekly challenge and unlock them from the highest level chest reward! 

You can join Lucky Clover with a buy-in of 25 million chips. You can also use a Lucky Clover ticket to play a free game of Lucky Clover, and you can claim free tickets from the diamond mission chest! Each ticket allows you one free game in the tournament!

What are you waiting for? Show off your good luck at the tables with the Lucky Clover ring!

Please note: Lucky Clover tickets will only be valid while the event is active. Lucky Clover will end on April 17th 9 am CET.
